tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Disclaimer/Bidders responsibility Mandatory Site Inspection: Bidders are strictly required to visit all parks mentioned in the bid to assess their current physical condition, infrastructure and operational constraints prior to submitting their financial bid. Sufficiency of Tender: The Bidder shall be deemed to have satisfied themselves as to the correctness and sufficiency of their tender before quoting the rates. No claim for financial escalation or variation in rates will be entertained post-award on the grounds of ignorance of site conditions, unforeseen labor requirements, or structural damages existing at the time of bidding.
The tender has been invited for a period of 12 months and the eligible bidder will be required to maintain all the parks once every 02 days for a period of 12 months.
